documents.review: Captions authored after visual inspection of each high-resolution coupling illustration; no force, tool, torque, or unpictured action is inferred.

steps.text: Release the retaining clip by hand in the numbered sequence shown. The arrows show the movement of each locking tab.
With the retaining clip released, pull the coupling straight off the tube as shown.
Release the retaining clip by hand. Follow the two numbered movements: press at the lower release point, then lift the retainer as shown.
With the retainer released, pull the coupling straight away from the tube.
Line the coupling up with the tube and push it straight onto the tube in the direction of the arrow.
Press the retaining clip back down into its seated position as shown.
Press the locking tab in the direction of the arrow to release this coupling type. Use your fingers; do not pry it with a tool.
Hold the locking tab in the release position shown while pushing the coupling onto the tube.
Move the locking tab back in the direction shown to secure the coupling.
Press the two release points marked 1, then move the retainer in the direction marked 2.
Lift the released coupling straight off the tube, following the arrow.
Align the coupling with the tube and push it straight down onto the tube as shown.
Press the release points marked 1, then lift the retaining clip in the direction marked 2.
With the retaining clip released, pull the coupling straight off the tube along the direction shown.
Push the coupling onto the tube in the direction marked 1, then press the retaining clip down in the direction marked 2.
